project.title: Microbial community responses of suspended sludge and biofilm in a continuous-flow IFAS-AOA system under changing landfill leachate loading
project.description: This project investigates the microbial community responses of suspended sludge and biofilm in a continuous-flow IFAS-AOA system during changes in landfill leachate loading. 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing was used to characterize changes in microbial community composition and succession associated with reactor operation and nitrogen removal performance. The resulting data provide insights into the microbial mechanisms underlying biological nitrogen removal from real landfill leachate.
